definitions.frames: Chrome native FireAnimationFrame callbacks belonging to the product main frame; no RAF or performance clock replacement. Counted over native performance marks. 59Hz threshold allows native 60Hz scheduling/window boundaries.
definitions.draws: Actual WebGL2 drawArrays/drawElements including instanced methods, delimited by renderer auto-clear with start timestamp/view fixed before drawing; production uses one render pass. Probe wrappers count calls without altering clock.
definitions.limitations: This host/headless Chromium/SwiftShader GPU only; Trace recording and API counters add overhead. Static call-light frames have draw-call records and FPS N/A.  not physical phones or representative user devices; native callback rate and Canvas draws are not display-panel presentation FPS. No full-story duration, long-term memory, hearing or external user acceptance.
